notes.title: Patch Notes - Auto-Save, New Map, and Multiplayer In-Game Chat
notes.content:
Dear Air Traffic Controllers, we have just performed a regular update, here are the details of the update.

[New Content]
1. Added a new map: Indianapolis International Airport (KIND), has been added. It is located in the heart of Indiana, adjacent to the world-famous Indianapolis Motor Speedway.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/df74ed2dced466b3a909cdae13096587af2f78c5.png[/img]

2. Added a game save feature: When no special events occur, the game will automatically save every day (in game), and it will also save when exiting the game. 
Note: After using this feature, the game results of this session will not be counted in the leaderboard.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/840f90c93a1a30d991f601123d65fbab7b500af5.png[/img]

3. Added a multiplayer chat (press the Enter key to use) and a speed adjustment quick request (automatically sent after a room guest clicks the speed adjustment function).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/963856cf63652a92186711d81ebd7024c514c8a3.jpg[/img]

4. The built-in maps in multiplayer mode can now be selected between London and Indianapolis.

notes.title: Multiplayer Mode, Start! - Patch notes v0.10.2
notes.content:
Attention all air traffic controllers, we have just released a major version update! Here are the contents of this update:

[Update Contents]
1. Support for multiplayer online gameplay.
2. That's it. (Less text, bigger news!)

[Multiplayer Gameplay Instructions]
1. We have added an initial interface entry for the multiplayer mode, which will be visible after the update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/e00a660172205ba79f65a20e1420a73bb9a93427.png[/img]

2. After entering multiplayer mode, the game lobby will display all public online rooms and the current map being played. Players can choose to join a public room directly, enter a private room by entering the room code, or create your own room.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/d00993195bd6d4759256d346511c7d5c8d25fc06.png[/img]

3. Online rooms support Creative Workshop maps, and members who join later do not need to download the workshop map to play.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/c2ad403cfb61268ae2fa3df58cb14a3cd51ad4ae.png[/img]

4. Usually, after joining a room, you need to click the ready button, and wait host to start the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/918a243234643a05f9b50a63b485b82896f52ea5.png[/img]

5. In online mode, you can view the current room code in the lower left corner of the interface, and your teammates' mouse pointers will appear as white dots. Planes in the map can be controlled by everyone, and in-game upgrades, game speed, and pause options are all controlled by the host.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/d71c6c3e3c54bfa5366bb62cdbdb3c1e41436483.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.8.2 - New Map, Borderless Window, Bug fixes
notes.content:
Air Traffic Controllers, we have just released our first update since the official game launch. In addition to adding a new map and the highly requested borderless window mode, we have also fixed several bugs reported since the game went live.

[New Content]
1. Added a new map: La Palma Airport.
2. Added a borderless window mode (Fullscreen Windowed in Options) for Windows. This mode helps prevent some issues caused by fullscreen mode.
3. Introduced Camera Offset functionality in the map editor.

[Bug Fixes]
1. Fixed an issue where the leaderboard would not refresh when switching modes.
2. Fixed an issue where the no-fly zone indicator would block the taxiing area on high-resolution screens.
3. Fixed a bug where Air Force One could collide with other aircraft off-screen.
4. Fixed issues leading to false Traffic alerts in certain scenarios.
5. Fixed an issue where scores over 999 would not display correctly.
6. Addressed other known bugs.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/5659465457526d995fe911a110c8ab9733c2aa55.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/90acf211b2e46e6c70674aa3e068cd84c8a95d17.png[/img]

notes.title: Mini Airways: Prologue
notes.content:
Dear air traffic controllers,

We're excited to announce the release of Mini Airways: Prologue today! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2856080/

[b]The content update is as follows:[/b]
1. Changed the map selection UI, adopting a design similar to airport departure boards, and we've included a switch in the settings where you can choose between the old and new UI. We'll continue to make improvements to this UI and the start menu UI.

notes.title: MINI AIRWAYS DEMO Update - Steam Cloud Storage
notes.content:
Dear air traffic controllers, the update is now live in our demo.


[New Features]
[list]
[*] Steam Cloud Storage: Game progress can now be synced across multiple gaming devices.
[*] Aircraft Status Indicator: Add indicators to show whether the aircraft have been given the specific commands.
[*] No Ground Air Collision Mode [i](For entertainment only, scores will not be uploaded)[/i] : In this mode, the aircraft in the air will not collide with the aircraft on the ground.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841008/e423ab1ebb0560b709cf4f3ca44acb37335acef2.jpg[/img]

[Feature Adjustments]
[list]
[*] Holding Waypoint will play animation before being placed to elimate the confusion of the turning direction.
[/list]

[Bugfix]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where in some cases the red warning light flashes continually after the aircraft goes around.
[*] Fixed some mistakes in the subtitles.
[/list]

notes.title: MINI AIRWAYS DEMO Update - Linux Compatibility
notes.content:
Dear air traffic controllers, the update is now live in our demo.


[New Features]
[list]
[*] New feature in Map Editor: Added support for "Center" (C) runway among L, C, R runways.
[*] Linux compatibility: Added native support for the Linux OS.
[/list]

[Feature Adjustments]
[list]
[*] Please add the game to your wishlist to support us! Added an "Add to Wishlist" button.
[*] Navigation waypoint behavior: Aircraft now will attempt to fly out following the direction of the arrow on the waypoint.
[/list]

notes.title: MINI AIRWAYS DEMO Update - Color Deficiency Accessibility
notes.content:
Dear Air Traffic Controllers，

We have an update in our demo. 


[New Features]
[list]
[*] Two supporting methods for color deficiency accessibility.
[*] Be able to adjust the volome of BGM independently from command audio volume.
[/list]

[Bugfix]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where RUNWAY LENGTH will be reset to default value after reload in LEVEL EDITOR.
[/list]

notes.title: MINI AIRWAYS DEMO Update - More features in Level Editor
notes.content:
Dear Air Traffic Controllers，

We have an update in our demo. 


[New Features]
[list]
[*] New features in Level Editor: Customizing restricted areas, terrains and mountains, single-direction airspace and variable length runways.
[*] Screenshot button on game over page: Go back To the last frame before the game is over for taking screenshots.
[/list]

[New Arts]
[list]
[*] Updated Game Over Page. 
[/list]

[Updated Features]
[list]
[*] Changed the text of "Target waypoint" to "Desination waypoint".
[*] Made different audios for going to desination waypoints and non-destination waypoints.
[/list]

notes.title: MINI AIRWAYS DEMO Update - "LEVEL EDITOR" arrives!
notes.content:
Dear Air Traffic Controllers，

We have an update in our demo. 


[New Features]
[list]
[*] Level Editor: Customizing your own airspace and airports. Customizing runways, aircrafts spawn frequency and map background is now available.
[/list]

[New Arts]
[list]
[*] Updated Map Selection Page. 
[/list]

[Updated Features]
[list]
[*] Slightly decreased the time for putting the "HOLDING WAYPOINT". 
[*] Changed the player action of putting the "NAVIGATION WAYPOINT" from "Click" to "Long Press".
[*] Auto navigation will only be triggered when player drags an aircraft onto the "NAVIGATION WAYPOINT". 
[*] Slightly decreased the frequency of audio warning.
[*] Updated the text of the "GAME OVER" Page.
[/list]

[Bugfix]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where aircraft spawn in wrong position in "WASHINGTON".
[*] Fixed a bug where in rare cases the icon of an aircraft leaves its border.
[/list]

notes.title: MINI AIRWAYS DEMO Update - Map "WASHINGTON" arrives!
notes.content:
Dear Air Traffic Controllers，

We have an update in our demo. 


[Change]
[list]
[*] Added new map KDCA: Reagan Washington National Airport.
[*] Added a new airspace mechanic which only allows aircraft to pass the airspace from one side and not the other.
[*] Added a new upgrade choice "NAVIGATION WAYPOINT".
[*] Added new tutorials for "RESTRICTED AREA", "MOUNTAINS" and "GO AROUND".
[/list]

[Bugfix]
[list]
[*] Fixed some known aircraft control issues.
[*] Fixed a bug where the manual time control is allowed when the upgrade panel is showing.
[/list]
